quest.title: Light Guiding Ceremony
quest.description: The entrance to Stormterror's Lair is just ahead, but the light seals bar the way in. You must once again face a trial in order to break those seals.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x375, Primogem x20, Mora x11325, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x2

chapter.title: Song of the Dragon and Freedom

talks.objective: Investigate the seal at the top of the tower

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: There are three more halos circling the tower...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Which means, there are three more corresponding <color=#00E1FFFF>light actuators</color> to activate.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I can see one from here.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The rest must be scattered within the ruins around here. Let's go find them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Why did Dvalin pick a place filled with puzzles and seals as his lair? Doesn't he get annoyed coming back home?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: He doesn't walk in, he flies in.

talks.objective: Break the seal in Stormterror's Lair
Break the seal in Stormterror's Lair
Break the seal in Stormterror's Lair
Investigate all of the light beams

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! This <color=#00E1FFFF>light actuating ceremony</color> does work magic!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: What are you waiting for? Go unlock the <color=#00E1FFFF>light actuator</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: If you don't try, you'll never know.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: There's no time to waste. We need to get these <color=#00E1FFFF>light actuators</color> unlocked.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: We've come this far, there's no turning back now. We'll just have to deal with them one by one.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: This light actuator is connecting to the others...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I've never encountered such annoying historical relics as these.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It seems there are <color=#00E1FFFF>three of them</color>. Looks like they can only be unlocked one at a time.
